Rhea: FYI I hit a weird parity gap between the browser and node SDKs when trying to run the eval harness in the Next sample app. Browser client streams tokens fine, node client used by the eval harness returns truncated messages during backoff.
Omar: which SDK versions?
Rhea: `@redwood/sdk` 0.10.1 in the browser, but our eval harness uses the Node API wrapper that still imports `node-fetch` poly and an old stream handler.
Li: short-term: tweak the harness to use the browser streaming shim. I can PR that to the sample so CI evals match local browser.
devex-bot: Note: file an issue for SDK parity tracking and assign to eng-ml for visibility.
Rhea: thanks, will do.
